name: Fuzzy Match Word Count Step
overview: Counts the words in text units whose top alternate translation is a plain fuzzy match — a `FUZZY` match type, where the leveraged result matches the source text and/or its inline codes only partially. The count is recorded as a word-count metric in a `MetricsAnnotation` so that scoping and pricing steps can report leveraged volume by match category. It is one of the categorized counters in the Word/Character Count family and is typically run after a leveraging step has annotated segments with their match types.
processingNotes: Operates per segment: it inspects the first (top-ranked) `AltTranslation` on each target segment's `AltTranslationsAnnotation` and counts a segment only when that match type is exactly `FUZZY`.
Counting is performed on the **source** text, not the target — the word total reflects the source volume that was leveraged at this match level.
Words are counted with the GMX-V word counter; the parallel character-count variant counts characters instead.
Counts only translatable text units; empty text units and non-translatable ones are skipped.

Results are stored as annotations on filter events and aggregated to the configured levels (text unit, group, document, sub-document, batch item, batch); the step produces no output document of its own.

Belongs to the `OKAPI_WORD_COUNTS` category group. When several categories in the same group match a segment, the `CategoryResolver` keeps only the highest-ranked one — `FUZZY` outranks `FUZZY_REPAIRED`, `PHRASE_ASSEMBLED`, `MT`, and `CONCORDANCE`, but is outranked by the unique-id, previous-version, and all exact categories.
